tytul: Dried salted fish (vobla, taran): why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for dried salted fish such as vobla or taran, which is traditionally salted and dried whole, without gutting.

ostrzezenia.tekst: According to the FDA, gut any fish before salting, drying, pickling or fermenting it.
The FDA considers uneviscerated (ungutted) fish that are salt-cured, dried or smoked a potentially life-threatening health hazard.
According to the FDA, these products are hazardous whether they are stored at room temperature, in the refrigerator or in the freezer.

akapity: The FDA reports that kapchunka, an ungutted salted and dried fish, caused botulism outbreaks with deaths in the USA.
JarAtlas has found no tested home recipe for dried salted fish, gutted or ungutted from a checked source.
